title: Appalachian Onslaught
description:
Build Your Ultimate Stronghold 

Every great defence starts with a formidable base. Fortify your lands with a massive arsenal of structures, tailoring your strategy to crush the incoming hordes.

• Unleash Sheer Firepower: Deploy an array of deadly towers—ranging from trusty archer posts to arcane spires that call down lightning from the heavens to smite your foes

• Grow Your Forces: Construct unit spawners to increase your army limit and fight back with overwhelming numbers

• Total Tactical Freedom: Your base, your rules. Place buildings anywhere you like, rotate them for the perfect angle, and demolish old structures to adapt to new threats. Design the perfect layout to suit your Chief's grand strategy

Forge an Unstoppable Tribal Army 

Never face the onslaught alone. Use the spoils from defeated waves to unlock new troops and build a force capable of rivaling the most brutal cryptids.

• Permanent Roguelite Progression: Death is only a setback. While your run may reset, your unlocked troops are yours forever. The moment you gather the resources on your next attempt, your army is ready to deploy

• Limitless Upgrades: Don't just hold the line—dominate it. There is no skill cap, meaning you can continuously upgrade your forces until they become truly god-like units capable of crushing any enemy

Hold the Line 

Your mission is simple: stop a relentless horde of Appalachian cryptids from breaching the Mountain Pass. In this infinite roguelite defender, the onslaught only ends when you or your base falls. Build, upgrade, and fight tooth and nail to prevent the wilderness from reclaiming your lands.

Key Features:

• Face the Folklore: Survive unpredictable, randomized waves of 11 distinct cryptids—ranging from mutant boars to the terrifying Wendigo. Adapt your strategy to counter specialized enemy classes, including siege-breakers and deadly assassins

• Command & Construct: Master a dynamic, free-placement building system. Deploy 4 unique tower types and command 6 distinct troop classes, scaling your army from humble Spear Warriors to towering Mountain Golems

• Infinite Roguelite Progression: There is no level cap. Infinitely upgrade your troops, defenses, and abilities to achieve god-like power. Push your limits by reaching Impossible+ Mode to permanently multiply your resource gains and push deeper into the endgame

• Empower Your Chief: Unlock a devastating arsenal of active and passive skills, transforming your Chief into a waking nightmare for the monster hordes

• Survive the Blood Moon: Face dynamic in-game events that dramatically alter the battlefield. Survive the grueling Blood Moon event and walk away with doubled or tripled rewards—if you live through the night
description_short: Stand your ground against the horrors of Appalachia! Build dynamic bases, forge a massive army, and survive endless waves of legendary cryptids in this roguelite base-defence game. Push your limits, infinitely upgrade your forces, and hold the mountain pass at all costs.
